projects.name: 编码Agent
projects.description: 一套面向编码代理（coding agent）的完整软件开发工作流解决方案，核心基于可组合的 “技能（Skills）” 体系和标准化执行指令，让编码代理能按照规范流程完成软件开发全周期工作，适配 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、OpenCode 等多个编码代理平台。
The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
A Claude Code plugin that shows what's happening - context usage, active tools, running agents, and todo progress

A complete AI agency at your fingertips** - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.

projects.name: Claude 编程学习
projects.description: Learn Claude Code 是一个教学型项目，系统整理了 Claude 在代码生成、理解和调试方面的实践方法，适合希望快速上手 AI 编程的开发者。
A light-weight and powerful meta-prompting, context engineering and spec-driven development system for Claude Code and OpenCode.
Fine-tuning & Reinforcement Learning for LLMs. 🦥 Train OpenAI gpt-oss, DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, Gemma, TTS 2x faster with 70% less VRAM.

projects.name: 人工智能技能库
projects.description: Skills 是一款基于人工智能的技能库平台，支持用户创建、管理和分享技能模型。它旨在通过AI提升技能自动化和个性化发展。

projects.name: 网络切换工具
projects.description: CC-Switch 是一个用于快速切换网络、代理或配置环境的实用工具，适合需要频繁在不同网络策略之间切换的开发者和测试人员。它通过简化配置与切换流程，减少手动修改成本，提高多环境调试和跨网络工作的效率。
